cases.description: A changed service function affects two HTTP handlers through direct and dependency-injected paths.

before.services.py:
def calculate_total(price: float, quantity: int) -> float:
    return price * quantity

after.services.py:
def calculate_total(price: float, quantity: int) -> float:
    return round(price * quantity, 2)

cases.description: A changed overloaded service method affects only the controller calling that signature.

before.PricingService.java: class PricingService { double calculate(String sku, int qty) { return qty * 10.0; } double calculate(String sku) { return 10.0; } }
before.PricingController.java: @RestController class PricingController { PricingService service; @PostMapping("/quotes") double quote(String sku, int qty) { return service.calculate(sku, qty); } @GetMapping("/prices/{sku}") double price(String sku) { return service.calculate(sku); } }

after.PricingService.java: class PricingService { double calculate(String sku, int qty) { return Math.round(qty * 10.0); } double calculate(String sku) { return 10.0; } }
after.PricingController.java: @RestController class PricingController { PricingService service; @PostMapping("/quotes") double quote(String sku, int qty) { return service.calculate(sku, qty); } @GetMapping("/prices/{sku}") double price(String sku) { return service.calculate(sku); } }

cases.description: A provider change propagates to two controller methods but not a separate health controller.

before.pricing.service.ts: @Injectable() export class PricingService { total(qty: number): number { return qty * 10; } }
before.pricing.controller.ts: @Controller('pricing') export class PricingController { constructor(private service: PricingService) {} @Post('quote') quote() { return this.service.total(2); } @Post('order') order() { return this.service.total(1); } }
before.health.controller.ts: @Controller('health') export class HealthController { @Get() health() { return {ok: true}; } }

after.pricing.service.ts: @Injectable() export class PricingService { total(qty: number): number { return Math.round(qty * 10); } }
after.pricing.controller.ts: @Controller('pricing') export class PricingController { constructor(private service: PricingService) {} @Post('quote') quote() { return this.service.total(2); } @Post('order') order() { return this.service.total(1); } }
after.health.controller.ts: @Controller('health') export class HealthController { @Get() health() { return {ok: true}; } }

cases.description: A producer SDK signature change affects an HTTP entrypoint in another repository.
An unused helper change must not affect the endpoint.
A required response property is removed and must be classified as a contract change.

before.openapi.yaml:
openapi: 3.0.0
paths:
  /users/{id}:
    get:
      responses:
        '200':
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                required: [id, email]
                properties:
                  id: {type: integer}
                  email: {type: string}

after.openapi.yaml:
openapi: 3.0.0
paths:
  /users/{id}:
    get:
      responses:
        '200':
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                required: [id]
                properties:
                  id: {type: integer}
